audit_status.source_base: Greek Colossians text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for above-things, old/new human, compassion/love, peace, word of Messiah, household code with safeguards.

verses.restored: Therefore, if you were raised together with Messiah, seek the things above, where Messiah is, seated at the right hand of the Divine.

familiar.text: If ye then be risen with Christ, seek those things which are above, where Christ sitteth on the right hand of God.

verses.restored: Set your mind on the things above, not the things upon earth.

familiar.text: Set your affection on things above, not on things on the earth.

verses.restored: For you died, and your life has been hidden with Messiah in the Divine.

familiar.text: For ye are dead, and your life is hid with Christ in God.

verses.restored: When Messiah, your life, is made manifest, then you also will be made manifest with him in glory.

familiar.text: When Christ, who is our life, shall appear, then shall ye also appear with him in glory.

verses.restored: Therefore put to death the members upon the earth: sexual immorality/misuse, uncleanness, passion, harmful desire, and greed, which is idolatry.

familiar.text: Mortify therefore your members which are upon the earth; fornication, uncleanness, inordinate affection, evil concupiscence, and covetousness, which is idolatry:

verses.restored: Because of these things the wrath of the Divine is coming.

familiar.text: For which things’ sake the wrath of God cometh on the children of disobedience:

verses.restored: In these you also once walked, when you were living in them.

familiar.text: In the which ye also walked some time, when ye lived in them.

verses.restored: But now you also put away all these: anger, fury, harmfulness, slander, shameful speech from your mouth.

familiar.text: But now ye also put off all these; anger, wrath, malice, blasphemy, filthy communication out of your mouth.

verses.restored: Do not lie to one another, having stripped off the old human with its practices,

familiar.text: Lie not one to another, seeing that ye have put off the old man with his deeds;

verses.restored: and having put on the new human, being renewed into knowledge according to image of the One who created it,

familiar.text: And have put on the new man, which is renewed in knowledge after the image of him that created him:

verses.restored: where there is not Greek and Judean, circumcision and uncircumcision, barbarian, Scythian, enslaved, free, but Messiah is all and in all.

familiar.text: Where there is neither Greek nor Jew, circumcision nor uncircumcision, Barbarian, Scythian, bond nor free: but Christ is all, and in all.

verses.restored: Therefore, as chosen ones of the Divine, holy and beloved, put on inward compassions, kindness, humility, gentleness, patience,

familiar.text: Put on therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering;

verses.restored: bearing with one another and graciously forgiving each other, if anyone has complaint against another; just as the Lord graciously forgave you, so also you.

familiar.text: Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also do ye.

verses.restored: And over all these things, love, which is bond of completeness.

familiar.text: And above all these things put on charity, which is the bond of perfectness.

verses.restored: And let the peace of Messiah rule in your hearts, into which also you were called in one body; and become thankful.

familiar.text: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also ye are called in one body; and be ye thankful.

verses.restored: Let the word of Messiah dwell in you richly, in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another, with psalms, hymns, spiritual songs, in grace singing in your hearts to the Divine.

familiar.text: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord.

verses.restored: And everything, whatever you do in word or work, do all in the name of Lord Jesus, giving thanks to the Divine Father through him.

familiar.text: And whatsoever ye do in word or deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God and the Father by him.

verses.restored: Wives, be subject to husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.

familiar.text: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as it is fit in the Lord.

verses.restored: Husbands, love wives and do not become bitter toward them.

familiar.text: Husbands, love your wives, and be not bitter against them.

verses.restored: Children, obey parents in all things, for this is pleasing in the Lord.

familiar.text: Children, obey your parents in all things: for this is well pleasing unto the Lord.

verses.restored: Fathers, do not provoke your children, lest they become discouraged.

familiar.text: Fathers, provoke not your children to anger, lest they be discouraged.

verses.restored: Enslaved ones, obey in all things earthly masters, not in eye-service as people-pleasers, but in sincerity of heart, fearing/revering the Lord.

familiar.text: Servants, obey in all things your masters according to the flesh; not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but in singleness of heart, fearing God:

verses.restored: Whatever you do, work from soul/life, as to the Lord and not to humans,

familiar.text: And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;

verses.restored: knowing that from the Lord you will receive the repayment of the inheritance; you serve the Lord Messiah.

familiar.text: Knowing that of the Lord ye shall receive the reward of the inheritance: for ye serve the Lord Christ.

verses.restored: For the one doing wrong will receive back the wrong one did, and there is no partiality.

familiar.text: But he that doeth wrong shall receive for the wrong which he hath done: and there is no respect of persons.

safety_note: Colossians 3 household code is preserved as ancient instruction but must not sanctify domination, abuse, coercive parenting, or slavery. It is read through the surrounding new-human body ethic: compassion, kindness, gentleness, forgiveness, love, peace, and no partiality.
